title: Millenium Prayer
lyrics_plain:
Our Father who art in heaven hallowed be thy name
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as in heaven
Give us today our daily bread and forgive our sins
As we forgive each one of those who sins against us
And lead us not to the time of trial, but deliver us from evil
For thine is the kingdom, the power and the glory

Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as in heaven
Give us today our daily bread and forgive our sins
As we forgive each one of those who sins against us

(And lead us not) lead us not (to the time of trial) to the time of trial
(But deliver us from evil) keep us from evil
For thine is the kingdom, the power and the glory
Let all the people say amen in every tribe and tongue
Let every heart's desire be joined to see the kingdom come

(Let every hope) every hope (and every dream) every dream
(Be born in love again) be born in love
Let all the world sing with one voice
Let the people say amen

Let all the people say amen (let all the people say)
In every tribe and tongue (in every tribe and tongue)
Let every heart's desire be joined (let every heart's desire)
To see the kingdom come

Let every hope and every dream be born in love
Yeah
Let all the world sing with one voice
Let the people say amen

Amen, amen, amen
Amen, amen, amen
Amen, amen, amen
Amen, amen, amen
